literate.definition: A person who is able to read and write.

civilizations.definition: An organized culture encompassing many communities, often on the scale of a nation or a people; a stage or system of social, political or technical development.

developed.definition: To change with a specific direction, progress.

medieval.definition: Someone living in the Middle Ages.

precedes.definition: To go before, go in front of.

prehistoric.definition: Having lasted from a remote period; having been of long duration; of great age, very old.

ancient.definition: A person who is very old.

emergence.definition: The act of rising out of a fluid, or coming forth from envelopment or concealment, or of rising into view; sudden uprising or appearance.

classical.definition: One that is classical in some way; for example, a classical economist.
